# Source and license

Copied unchanged from the public Hugging Face dataset `apurvaga/swe-rebench-v2-qwen38-27b-bo3-openhands` (https://huggingface.co/datasets/apurvaga/swe-rebench-v2-qwen38-27b-bo3-openhands), license CC BY 4.0, on 2026-09-29. It is an outcome and compute overlay for `nebius/SWE-rebench-V2` at revision `10c49ab856fd0e62097815ba5909dfc4f31e7f93`: model Qwen3.8-27B with OpenHands, three seeded rollouts per task, campaign `qwen38-swe-rebench-verified-all-bo3-ctx262k-seed20260822`. It contains no raw trajectories, patches or tests. The dataset card marks it as an incomplete snapshot (15,209 of 18,816 rollout slots validly scored), so it must not be reported as a final pass@3.
